title: Virtual Open Tennis
native_title: バーチャル・オープン・テニス
overview:
Gorgeous form and dynamic play recreated on a full-polygon court!! You are the one who will land the glorious final stroke!!

Virtual Open Tennis is a men's tennis game with ten fictional players and polygon courts in several surfaces. Hit lobs, slices, topspin and volleys, and use the on-court marker that shows where the ball will land.

- Tournament mode with the beginner Challengers Cup and the tougher Imagineer World Championship
- Exhibition matches in singles or doubles, with computer partners filling empty spots
- Training for serves, smashes and returns
- Multiple camera views and action replays
- 1 to 4 players with the multi-terminal 6 adaptor
